listing.title: Cocoa Season Shirt, Watercolor Hot Cocoa Tee, Cozy Winter Christmas Shirt, Hot Chocolate Lover Gift, Marshmallow Holiday Top
listing.description: A steaming red mug of hot cocoa, piled with marshmallows and a cinnamon stick, sits among snowy pine boughs with a peppermint, star anise, holly and a dried orange slice, painted in layered watercolor under "Cocoa Season" in warm script and "extra marshmallows, please" below. Made for snow days, holiday movie nights and anyone who keeps the cocoa tin full from the first frost on.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-09-30 (before any art): web searches '"cocoa season" trademark clothing', '"COCOA SEASON" trademark USPTO registration', '"cocoa season" brand apparel' and '"extra marshmallows please" trademark OR shirt' found no COCOA SEASON or EXTRA MARSHMALLOWS PLEASE registration, filing or apparel brand. Clothing marks that contain COCOA use different wording (COCOAMATO, filed 2021 for clothing; LA COCOA; the Cocoa Spain label); the chocolate marks seen (COCOA K'CHOO, COCOA BOMBS, COCOA BAMA, UN COCOA LOCO) cover food, not apparel or mugs. 'Cocoa season' and 'hot cocoa season' are used descriptively by independent sellers. Kept out: the crowded phrase 'Hot Cocoa Weather', any cocoa or marshmallow brand, the DJ name Marshmello, cereal brands. tmsearch.uspto.gov, Justia and uspto.report pages are blocked from our sessions, so the official database was not searched directly; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
